key_insight: GeoABC injects boundary geometry as a direction-aware prior so neural operators can treat wall-parallel and wall-normal physics differently near solid surfaces.
engineering_relevance: This improves near-wall aerodynamic predictions for shape design workflows, where pressure and flow accuracy at boundaries strongly affect CFD surrogate quality.
method: Uses geometry-conditioned anisotropic boundary correction in intermediate neural-operator features.
Separates tangential and normal boundary behaviors instead of applying isotropic treatment.
Works as a plug-in across multiple neural operator backbones.
evidence_signal: On 2D airfoil and 3D car benchmarks, GeoABC reduces near-boundary relative L2 error by about 38% on average.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on accurate boundary geometry encoding, so noisy meshes or complex wall representations may weaken the correction.
paper_title: Geometry-Aware Anisotropic Boundary Correction for Aerodynamic Simulation
